The content I could access was quite brief; I’d suggest adding a short bio and a few examples of your work or interests so visitors can get a better sense of who you are. I could only review the text available to me, not the visual design.

final_text:
Visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack using the email listed on her site, and messaged both with feedback:

- **Dora:** Suggested adding a short bio and examples of her work or interests.
- **Eve:** Suggested sharing hiking stories, favorite trails, and practical tips.

I noted that my feedback was based on the limited text available, not the visual design.
